Seed 2009 is a retreat and openspace event for members and friends of the [[SolSeed Movement]].

== When ==
January 9,10, and a half day on January 11.  We have [[FalconsCrestLodge|the lodge]] from 3pm Thursday January 8 through 11am Monday morning January 12.

{{:Seed 2009/Invitation}}

== Where ==
[[Image:FalconsCrestInside.gif|right]]
[[FalconsCrestLodge]] on Mount Hood, about 1 hour from Portland sleeps 24 and has numerous cozy spaces for [[OpenSpace]] sessions and a satellite Internet connection.


== [[Seed 2009/Invitation|Invitation]] ==
You are receiving this invitation because someone wants to see you at Seed 2009.  Seed 2009 is an un-conference for the folks who will build a community that "Brings Life" to each of us, to our communities, and to the entire galaxy.

To learn more, visit [[Seed 2009]] and add yourself to  [[Seed_2009/Participants|the participants list]] if you're planning to attend.
